comparison.assumptions: Compared with v1. Static gravity peak over 0–40 mm, estimated from 401 poses with bounded refinement; PETG 1.27 g/cm³ at 100% solid fraction (solid-equivalent estimate); assumed 280 g motor in both estimates. Steel hardware 7.85 g/cm³; 625ZZ bearings 5 g each. Modeled metal probe included; microscope and specimen excluded. Actual print mass depends on material and toolpaths; this is not a structural load rating.

notes.fit: Compact end mount for a Ø44 mm microscope, 100 mm working distance, 40 mm straight vertical probe travel and a 60° probe approach. The external collet holds a 6 mm shank; only the probe enters the projected barrel corridor. The projected footprint is a clearance assumption, not a measured lens field of view.
notes.validation: All 48 components are valid single solids and passed STEP roundtrip checks. No intersections at 41 checked poses; Ø44 projected barrel corridor clear of non-probe parts. Each pose includes all 1128 component pairs, with no excluded parts or regions. The alternative full-length Ø6 mm probe was checked against every other component. The independent continuous optical report validates the final world-space transform. Physical collision checks are sampled; strength, stiffness, backlash and print fit need physical validation.
notes.exports: The bundle includes 48 component STEP files, 7 printable-part STLs, assembly STEP/GLB, source, requirements, viewer geometry, manifest, checksums and all verification and mass/moment comparison reports. Mass and static moment values are estimates under the report assumptions. Genuine Parasolid x_t export is unavailable; use a CAD tool with a licensed writer to export STEP as x_t. STEP/STL files share assembly placement; arrange STL orientations for manufacture.
